en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a Romanesque cathedral dominating a town square. The building has a tall, polygonal bell tower with paired arched openings, an apse with blind arcades, and a smaller, ornate porch-like structure with columns and a gabled roof in front. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk and stand around the fenced area in front of the church. Townhouses line the street on the left; a large domed structure and additional stone buildings appear behind the cathedral.
